description: Generate a liability disclaimer (general, medical, financial, fitness, legal, or affiliate) for a website or app using privacypage.io. Returns a free 25-line preview and a documentId; the full document is unlocked with a one-time license ($9.99, no subscription).

companyName.description: Company name, if different from the site name, e.g. 'Acme Inc.'

disclaimerType.description: The type of disclaimer that matches the site's content

externalLinks.description: Whether the site links to external websites

websiteName.description: Name of the website or app, e.g. 'MyApp'
